notes: The ICT page does not state a tuition fee for non-EU students; the € 2.694,- mentioned is the statutory tuition fee (wettelijk collegegeld) and the studiekosten page says a higher institutional fee may apply if you do not meet the statutory criteria. No document list for international applicants could be quoted from the ICT page. The intake dates are on the ICT page. The URL slug contains 'almere' but the ICT programme page found is for Zwolle; no ICT page for the Almere variant was supplied.

note.fr: Un diplôme étranger équivalent à un diplôme néerlandais de havo, vwo ou mbo-4 est requis. Vérifiez les exigences linguistiques applicables.
note.en: A foreign diploma equivalent to a Dutch havo, vwo or mbo-4 diploma is required. Check the applicable language requirements.

evidence.quote: Je bent toelaatbaar met een diploma dat gelijkwaardig is aan een havo-, vwo- of mbo-4 diploma. Daarnaast moet je voldoen aan de taaleisen.
